identity.name: RM 67-02 Automatic Extra Flat
identity.one_liner: The slim Richard Mille — 38.7mm, 7.8mm thick, Carbon TPT case, automatic skeletonised movement. The most-cited Asian-friendly Mille.

provenance_events.description: Richard Mille releases the RM 67-02 — a 38.7mm Carbon TPT case, 7.8mm thick, automatic CRMA7 calibre.

narrative.story: The RM 67-02 is Richard Mille's most-wearable reference — slim, lightweight, with the brand's first Carbon TPT tonneau case. The case is 38.7mm and 7.8mm thick.
narrative.collector_notes: The case is 38.7mm but reads 40mm because of the tonneau shape. The dial is open-worked to show the movement.
